`sample_AC1032.dwg` is the AutoCAD 2018-format regression fixture from
[ACadSharp](https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp/blob/d9f3de8c9910b602d392aa1acc72b62c095ec40e/samples/sample_AC1032.dwg),
pinned at `d9f3de8c9910b602d392aa1acc72b62c095ec40e`.
The upstream MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

The test exercises the actual pinned converter WASM, rather than a mocked conversion.
